user.title: Connect Brick
user.description: Enter the address of your Brick instance and a voice token (scope "voice"). Create tokens in Brick under Profile → Paired devices. The calendar token (scope "calendar") or calendar URL is optional.

data_description.url: e.g. https://brick.example (with https://, no trailing slash)
data_description.calendar: Full ICS URL or just the calendar token

reauth_confirm.title: Brick: renew token
reauth_confirm.description: Brick ({url}) rejected the token. Create a new voice token in Brick and enter it here.

error.invalid_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.insecure_http: Warning: http:// outside your local network sends the token unencrypted. Use https://, or submit again to continue anyway.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Is it a voice token (scope "voice") and not revoked?
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: This Brick instance is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: Minimum 5 minutes. Each cycle uses three requests.

announce.name: Announce training
announce.description: Fetches the current training from Brick and speaks it on a speaker.

detail.name: Detail
detail.description: "Normal" also mentions form and race countdown.

tts_entity.name: TTS service
tts_entity.description: TTS entity used for speech (not needed for Alexa Media Player).

notify_service.name: Notify service (Alexa)
notify_service.description: Alexa Media Player, e.g. notify.alexa_media_echo_kueche. Used instead of the TTS service.

config_entry.name: Brick entry
config_entry.description: Only needed with several Brick instances.

refresh.name: Refresh now
refresh.description: Fetches Brick immediately (at most every 30 seconds).

config_entry.name: Brick entry
config_entry.description: Only needed with several Brick instances.

no_loaded_entry.message: Brick is not set up or not loaded.

announce_target_missing.message: Provide either speaker and TTS service, or a notify service.

invalid_notify_service.message: The notify service must look like notify.<name>.
